summary: FTC Solar, Inc. filed an 8-K on October 5, 2026, reporting that on September 30, 2026 it entered into a Third Amendment and Limited Waiver to its July 2, 2025 Credit Agreement with its lenders and Acquiom Agency Services LLC as administrative agent. The amendment defers a $5,000,000 ECF repayment from September 30, 2026 to March 31, 2027, suspends minimum unrestricted cash, revenue and EBITDA covenants until January and March 2027, and modifies change-of-control and standstill terms. This is a routine credit-facility amendment, not a special situation; there is no deal, stake, premium or board recommendation to track.
